notes.title: The Last of Waifus 100 keys giveaway launching NOW!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35694047/a56cf7f75b4e5a4d62dd45b65e2916eddcae5097.png

To celebrate the release of our newest game The Last of Waifus launching on Monday, 10th of August this year, we want to give 100 keys to 100 lucky winners.

How to enter:
[olist]
 Wishlist & Follow The Last of Waifus 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35694047/a0b38d5b55c67382723cc8c5f7e7fb26a7c4a605.gif

 Follow Konnichiwa Games  Developer Page

 Share this announcement with your friends

Click the "Share" button under this post, choose "Share directly to my status" and post with your own comment.

 Write a comment under this post to let us know you are participating
[/olist]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359650/The_Last_of_Waifus/

We will announce the winners on Monday, 10th of August in "The Last of Waifus giveaway results" announcement — so stay tuned and do not miss out! 

We wish you the best luck!

Cheers, 
Konnichiwa Games

notes.title: The Last of Waifus: new game coming soon!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/2OzlAF4.gif

We want to announce our new game: The Last of Waifus. Fight the Infected, clear out the city, enjoy your Waifu!


The game will be release in mid July, more info soon..

Add The Last of Waifus to your Wishlist and be the first one in line!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359650/The_Last_of_Waifus/

Cheers,
Konnichiwa Games.
